# Towards Victory — Leaderboard on_action hooks
# Manually maintained — NOT generated by gen_victory.py
#
# monthly_country_pulse fires once per country per month.
# It updates per-country best-path variables for all countries (player + AI),
# then triggers a full leaderboard rebuild on the situation scope once per
# human player (idempotent; safe in multiplayer).

monthly_country_pulse = {
	effect = {
		# ── Cultural Victory: CIP +1 per country per month ──────────────────────────
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_cultural_influence_points } }
			set_variable = { name = tv_cultural_influence_points value = 0 }
		}
		change_variable = { name = tv_cultural_influence_points add = 1 }

		# ── Arts Exhibition: join IO on first M1 achievement ─────────────────────────
		# Block A: when a country first reaches Cultural Victory M1, create or join
		# the tv_arts_exhibition IO and initialise influence tracking variables.
		if = {
			limit = {
				tv_cultural_milestone_1 = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = tv_arts_exhibition_member }
			}
			set_variable = { name = tv_arts_exhibition_member value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_arts_intl_influence value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { exists = international_organization:tv_arts_exhibition } }
				create_international_organization = {
					type = international_organization_type:tv_arts_exhibition
					hidden_effect = {
						add_country_to_international_organization = prev
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				international_organization:tv_arts_exhibition = {
					add_country_to_international_organization = root
				}
			}
		}

		# ── Arts Exhibition: International Influence decay ────────────────────────────
		# Block B: decay -0.05 per month, floor 0.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = tv_arts_exhibition_member
				has_variable = tv_arts_intl_influence
			}
			change_variable = { name = tv_arts_intl_influence subtract = 0.05 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_arts_intl_influence < 0 }
				set_variable = { name = tv_arts_intl_influence value = 0 }
			}
		}

		# ── Arts Exhibition: touring event roll ───────────────────────────────────────
		# Block C: for each touring artist currently in THIS country's court, roll an
		# ~8% monthly chance (~1 event/year) for a touring outcome event on their home
		# country. Weights are stratified by artist_skill (low < 0.5 / mid 0.5–0.7 / high ≥ 0.7).
		every_character = {
			limit = {
				is_courtier = yes
				is_artist = yes
				has_variable = tv_on_exhibition
			}
			save_scope_as = touring_artist
			random = {
				chance = 8
				random_list = {
					# ── Unremarkable +0.1 ──────────────────────────────────────
					40 = {
						var:tv_exhibition_home_country ?= {
							change_variable = { name = tv_arts_intl_influence add = 0.1 }
							trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.101 }
						}
					}
					# ── Great Success +0.5 (skill-boosted) ─────────────────────
					15 = {
						trigger = { artist_skill < 0.5 }
						var:tv_exhibition_home_country ?= {
							change_variable = { name = tv_arts_intl_influence add = 0.5 }
							trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.102 }
						}
					}
					25 = {
						trigger = { artist_skill >= 0.5  artist_skill < 0.7 }
						var:tv_exhibition_home_country ?= {
							change_variable = { name = tv_arts_intl_influence add = 0.5 }
							trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.102 }
						}
					}
					40 = {
						trigger = { artist_skill >= 0.7 }
						var:tv_exhibition_home_country ?= {
							change_variable = { name = tv_arts_intl_influence add = 0.5 }
							trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.102 }
						}
					}
					# ── Terrible −0.1 (skill-reduced) ──────────────────────────
					30 = {
						trigger = { artist_skill < 0.5 }
						var:tv_exhibition_home_country ?= {
							change_variable = { name = tv_arts_intl_influence subtract = 0.1 }
							if = {
								limit = { var:tv_arts_intl_influence < 0 }
								set_variable = { name = tv_arts_intl_influence value = 0 }
							}
							trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.103 }
						}
					}
					15 = {
						trigger = { artist_skill >= 0.5  artist_skill < 0.7 }
						var:tv_exhibition_home_country ?= {
							change_variable = { name = tv_arts_intl_influence subtract = 0.1 }
							if = {
								limit = { var:tv_arts_intl_influence < 0 }
								set_variable = { name = tv_arts_intl_influence value = 0 }
							}
							trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.103 }
						}
					}
					5 = {
						trigger = { artist_skill >= 0.7 }
						var:tv_exhibition_home_country ?= {
							change_variable = { name = tv_arts_intl_influence subtract = 0.1 }
							if = {
								limit = { var:tv_arts_intl_influence < 0 }
								set_variable = { name = tv_arts_intl_influence value = 0 }
							}
							trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.103 }
						}
					}
					# ── Artist Hired +1.0, stays permanently ───────────────────
					5 = {
						var:tv_exhibition_home_country ?= {
							change_variable = { name = tv_arts_intl_influence add = 1.0 }
							trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.104 }
						}
						remove_variable = tv_on_exhibition
						remove_variable = tv_exhibition_home_country
						remove_variable = tv_exhibition_target_country
						remove_variable = tv_exhibition_location
						remove_variable = tv_exhibition_elapsed
						remove_variable = tv_exhibition_duration
					}
					# ── Inspiration: +10% artist_skill_level_gain for 10 years ─
					10 = {
						add_character_modifier = {
							modifier = tv_artistic_inspiration_modifier
							years = 10
							mode = add_and_extend
						}
						var:tv_exhibition_home_country ?= {
							trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_arts_exhibition.105 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		# Update this country's leading path / milestone / score for leaderboard display
		tv_update_best_path_effect = yes

		# Human player pulse: rebuild the global top-5 leaderboard on the situation scope
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			situation:tv_victory_situation = {
				tv_update_leaderboard_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
